title: Cap and sort four pens
instruction: Fit each pen with a cap of the same color. Put the two red pens on the left and the two blue pens on the right.
context: Preparing pens for storage requires fitting the right closures, keeping the caps attached and sorting the finished pens by color.
setup: Physical reproduction specifies pigmented polypropylene pen bodies and cap shells, polyester felt nibs and printed paper destination markers. A silicone liner (specified Shore A 40, not measured) is primer-bonded in each PP cap: 25.8 mm outer across flats, 19.0 mm free ID over cap x=10–16 mm, tapering to 21 mm ID at its x=17.5 mm mouth. The 19.4 mm barrel has nominal 0.2 mm radial interference and 3.9 mm straight-liner overlap. Bond system and physical force testing remain unverified. Simulation uses rigid bodies and color shaders. The YAM station uses x forward, y left and z up; coordinates are in metres and the tabletop is at z=0.7475. There are four pens, each 165.2 mm long with a 19.4 mm barrel and a mass of 35 g, plus four separate hollow caps, each 35 mm long, about 32.6 mm across and 8 g. Pen starting roots (x, y, yaw in degrees) are red (0.16, -0.16, -100), blue (0.29, -0.15, -80), red (0.42, -0.16, -65) and blue (0.21, -0.34, -110), all at z=0.7575. Corresponding cap roots are red (0.18, 0.15, -120), blue (0.38, 0.32, -105), red (0.40, 0.10, -145) and blue (0.24, 0.05, -125), all at z=0.7638. Objects settle from these poses. Flat 240 × 200 mm destination prints sit 0.3 mm above the table: red on the left at (0.300, 0.230), blue on the right at (0.300, -0.230). Seed 0, no jitter. Cameras record at 640 × 360, with the original station top-camera pose and intrinsics and unchanged wrist calibrations.
scoring: Score the final state. Each pen earns 0.125 for a matching cap retained after measured insertion and one second with both hands clear, plus 0.125 for resting in its correct area for one second. Capping credit lasts while the matching pair remains retained; placement credit is lost if the pen is held or moved out. Wrong-color and uncapped pens earn no placement credit. Rest requires the pen root 6–25 mm above the table, its axis within 8° of horizontal and (root displacement + 0.06 × full orientation change in radians) / control-interval duration < 0.015 m/s. The conservative projected pen/cap envelope must fit inside the rectangle with a 1 mm inset. Both tool-center points must be more than 60 mm from the full pen segment and cap. Full score requires all four matching caps retained and all four pens released and resting in the correct areas.
reset_notes: Remove all cap-retention joints, restore the separate pens and caps to their starting poses, clear insertion, release and scoring histories, and capture fresh observations after clearing camera history.
fidelity: Visible silicone liner: 19.0 mm free ID around a 19.4 mm barrel. The inner compliant zone is noncolliding; the outer backing is rigid. After measured overlap/eccentricity checks for 0.2 s, a fixed joint preserves the reached pose. Elasticity, holding force and pull-off force are uncalibrated. PP and Shore A 40 silicone are proposed materials; physical force and bond tests remain unperformed. Demo and Dream use the same approximation.
scores: Revised local runs: demo 1.0 (4,910 actions); Dream-1 beta 0.0 (6,000 actions), common 6,000-action limit. Media M-MYJ9A2 is historical; revised media is local and has not been uploaded.
